title: Source Register
description: Registers every compliance source document before requirement breakdown begins. One entry per document version.

version.description: Schema version number for this record.

source_type.description: High-level category of the source document.

document_title.description: Official title of the source document.

document_code.description: Document code or reference number (e.g., IWAY 6.0, ISO 14001:2015).

issuing_body.description: Who issued this document (e.g., IKEA, Vietnamese Government, Internal).

expiry_date.description: Date the document expires, if any.

scope_tags.description: Tags: environment, labour, health_safety, chemical, fire, social, ethics, trade, quality, etc.

applies_to_countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes this document applies to.

applies_to_facilities.description: Facility codes or names this document applies to.

has_been_broken_down.description: Whether this document has been processed through requirement breakdown.

requirement_count.description: Number of requirements extracted from this document.

storage_path.description: Relative path to the stored source file under data/knowledge/compliance/source_files/.

file_hash.description: SHA-256 of the original file for integrity.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code of the document.

review.description: Who reviewed this record and when.

reviewed_by.description: Person ID or name who reviewed.
